description: Na₁₀Co₄O₉ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are ten inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.37 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.40 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.39 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.35 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.37 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.53 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.34 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.56 Å. In the ninth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.35 Å. In the tenth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.40 Å. There are four inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.91 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.92 Å. In the third Co site, Co is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.94 Å. In the fourth Co site, Co is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.92 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Co atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Co atoms to form ONa₄Co₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₅Co octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄Co trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-58°. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Co atom to form distorted ONa₄Co trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six ONa₅Co octahedra, edges with two ONa₅Co octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Co trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-70°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form distorted ONa₅Co octahedra that share corners with six ONa₅Co octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₄Co trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₅Co octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Co trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-58°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-55°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Co atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form distorted ONa₅Co octahedra that share corners with five ONa₅Co octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄Co trigonal bipyramids, edges with two ONa₄Co₂ octahedra, and  a faceface with one ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-51°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form ONa₅Co octahedra that share corners with six ONa₅Co octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₄Co trigonal bipyramid, edges with two ONa₅Co octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Co trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-55°. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-53°.
